task.title: Add provider re-auth as device-flow skill assistant.provider.reauth
task.summary_zh: 新增 assistant.provider.reauth skill：以 service-user CODEX_HOME 執行 codex login --device-auth，安全回傳 verification_uri/user_code，背景追蹤登入完成並重新 probe readiness。
acceptance: Spike proves codex login --device-auth verification_uri and user_code can be captured headlessly;assistant.provider.reauth is a governed skill gated by kernel mode and control-mode passphrase;Surface carries only verification_uri user_code and poll status and never provider credential material;Token is written by the provider CLI into the service-user mount only;On success the adapter re-probes readiness and upstream returns to healthy;Tests cover start poll cancel expiry and credential-non-exposure
task.next: Closed out provider reauth skill after PR #1188 merged into dev at a2e8b55b2e48e35b4c2ca08a798046ef0b435865; reviewed delivery PR #1183 remains merged at fabc64ae954994e9dd7f0cfb5f3614a0773c13ac.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：device-auth 欄位嚴格限制，無憑證洩漏；BFF 正確要求 kernel_debug/kernel_repair 控制模式；背景重新探測就緒狀態正確
後續追蹤：可補充 timeout 情境測試（非阻礙）

handoffs.message: PR #1183 open for review: provider reauth device-flow skill, adapter/BFF routes, descriptor, docs, and focused tests are ready.
Review approved: credential isolation, kernel gate, and device-flow field restriction are all correct. Returning to Codex for closeout.
